frontier_behavior.mechanism: Empty outer grid borders prevented candidate-frontier generation. An intact seed restored candidates. Border trimming must preserve channel alignment and cannot fill interior holes.

native_drag_smoothing.mechanism: Default drag smoothing distributes motion to neighboring nodes. Zero smoothing was used when the intended experiment moved only the selected vertex.

normal_field_integration.result: Native grower consumed the CT-derived 3D normals. Central following improved; outer geometry still crossed folds.
